Wrong option 'Site-to-Site VPN connection from each consumer VPC to the billing VPC through virtual private gateways' describes an unsupported topology: a Site-to-Site VPN connects a virtual private gateway/transit gateway to a customer gateway device, not one VGW to another VGW.
